source_snapshot_scope: Root is actively editing. Hashes identify this review snapshot, not a promised final freeze or executed build.

findings.issue: Runtime adopted unpruned candidate while Store committed a pruned clone, causing memory/disk divergence and unbounded retained runtime history.
findings.resolution: Observed root fix: Runtime::persist prunes and validates the same candidate before copying it to Store and adopting it after durable commit.

findings.issue: Pruning oldest Finished job could orphan a retained session, making strict State::validate reject the next transaction. Concrete case: oldest finished job owns one retained verified session and 128 later finished jobs have none.
findings.resolution: Observed root fix: job pruning selects only Finished jobs with no retained session references.

findings.issue: Fast stop authorization error returned before actor dispatch, yielding EOF and bypassing fixed error reply and denial audit for existing IDs.
findings.resolution: Observed root fix: fast stop errors do not escape; request reaches actor authorization/error/audit path, while successful authorized stop remains independent of a slow durable transaction.

findings.issue: A previously evicted random request UUID was indistinguishable from a new Start, contradicting unconditional expired-ID rejection.
findings.resolution: Observed explicit RetryStart branch returns RequestExpired before any new intent or worker; CLI --retry requires --request-id. Ordinary Start remains an explicit new intent outside retained history.

findings.issue: Verified cleanup following soft timeout Error needs recovery transition and audit rather than direct state assignment.
findings.resolution: Observed Finish transition Error->Recovering->Disconnected with intermediate audit, preserving actual final cleanup requirement.

nonblocking_boundaries.issue: Removing a historical profile from the current manifest makes its retained records unavailable through per-profile RPC, including root, although unresolved state remains persisted and is not falsely retired.
nonblocking_boundaries.boundary: Parent notified; keep a profile until coordination or use protected state diagnostics. No new historical-query API was implemented by this reviewer.

nonblocking_boundaries.issue: Denied events use profile=None; the current profile-filtered Audit/Events RPC cannot return them.
nonblocking_boundaries.boundary: They are persisted and available in the protected state file; no global denial-history UI/RPC proof claimed.

nonblocking_boundaries: Audit is a bounded sequence history, not permanent archiving or complete Phase3 audit validation.
Heartbeat/RTT is unavailable in raw USB/IP v1; no synthetic health inference reviewed or claimed.
Individual Rust Export stop is intentionally unsupported; incoming session stop remains independently routed.
Reserved but unsent helper attempts may remain conservatively unconfirmed; this review does not reclassify them as recovered.
Legacy foreground commands remain separate adapters in this slice; same-runner extraction is not claimed.
reviewed_invariants: Kernel SO_PEERCRED determines local UID; stop capability lookup independently authorizes exact current profile/action before setting any watch. Opaque IDs are not bearer authorization.

RPC schema rejects unknown fields, accepts no arbitrary path/endpoint/certificate/helper request, and uses 65536-byte frames, 16 accepted requests and bounded pages under five-second request deadline.
Client verifies protected directory chain, socket owner/mode/type and inode identity plus server peer UID; root-managed manifest fixes endpoint and credential configuration.
State/control leaves and regular files are descriptor-relative, NOFOLLOW, owner/mode/nlink checked; endpoint/data locks and before/after identity checks reject conflicting or replaced state.
Store commit uses bounded encoding, file fsync, rename and directory fsync before success; failed recording refuses new admissions while independent cooperative stop remains available.
Durable job/session/attempt intent precedes worker start or helper request acknowledgement; UI task cancellation does not own or abort worker JoinSet tasks.
Runtime shutdown requests stop and waits for actual worker/recovery task return; request task lifetime is independent of device ownership.

Root recovery accepts only matching schema/kind/correlation/device key/broker UID/resource ID; Unknown or absent proof does not retire old state. Per-attempt proof kind remains visible in retained records.
CLI agent run owns signal handling and awaits service cleanup, including repeated signals; startup blocking load is joined on cancellation.
suggested_targeted_tests: Canonical state equality across runtime, committed store, and restart after more than 128 terminals and 256 requests.
Oldest finished job with one retained session and 128 later sessionless jobs remains referentially valid after pruning.
Unauthorized actual UDS Stop returns fixed Permission response, records Denied, and does not set stop flags.
RetryStart unknown/expired ID creates no job/session/worker; retained exact UID/profile retry returns original job; cross-UID/profile reuse denied.
Per-session stop under slow durable recording still reaches owner while unrelated session transfers continue.
Actual cleanup after soft Error produces Recovering then Disconnected and preserves operation-vs-cleanup evidence.
Kernel helper exact terminal proof permits old attempt reconciliation; mismatched kind/key/UID/correlation/resource and Unknown never retire it.
